notes.title: Match & Mastery @ PAX AUSTRALIA
notes.notes:
FourFox Interactive is bringing Match & Mastery to PAX Australia this October! Get ready to dive into a thrilling combination of match-3 puzzles and turn-based tactical gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177741/a61adacdd4330c992f0e9292c2acde5fe81806af.png[/img]

Come by the New Zealand Center of Digital Excellence booth (#1140) for an exclusive hands-on experience with the game, and be among the first to see our latest updates! We’ll be gathering valuable feedback from players like you to help us fine-tune Match & Mastery as we prepare for release.

Don’t miss this opportunity to meet the FourFox Interactive team, try out the demo, and see what else is coming out of New Zealand's indie gaming scene. We can’t wait to hear what you think!


[h2][b]About Match & Mastery![/b][/h2]

At Chroma Academy... Learn a craft. Harness magic. Discover your true calling. And maybe, save the world.

Join the next generation of young wizards as they clean-up and combat hazardous environments and enemies, to restore balance in a land corrupted by poisonous fallout from an ancient magical battle between two feuding sorceress sisters.


[h3]Match-3 Gameplay Directly Impacts Your Tactical Strategy![/h3]

Your match-3 combos determine your movement range, and your match-3 score dictates the damage you can inflict.

[h3]Procedurally Generated Maps and Rooms.[/h3]

No two runs are ever the same, offering a fresh experience with different rooms, enemies, and layouts each time you play.

[h3]Item Based Character Builds.[/h3]

Create new character builds in every run by collecting various items that can significantly alter your character's progression and playstyle throughout the game.

[h3]Follow Our Development.[/h3]

You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189890/Match__Mastery/]wishlist Match & Mastery now[/url], and follow our development on [url=https://x.com/FourFoxInt]X @FourFoxInt[/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fourfoxinteractive]Tiktok @FourFoxInteractive[/url]
